# FormLogic: app-building guide for AI assistants

FormLogic hosts forms, app dashboards, automations and editable Softn projects
with private .logic backend actions and per-app SQLite databases.

## Start
- Human-readable onboarding: /ai-setup (public, no account required).
- Create account: /signup?redirect=%2Fconnect-ai
- Sign in: /login?redirect=%2Fconnect-ai
- Guided OAIY or API-provider setup: /connect-ai
- MCP endpoint: /api/mcp on this site's origin.
- OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/mcp
- API and product documentation: /docs

Use labelled controls when assisting through the browser. Let the user complete
account verification, OAuth consent and hardware pairing. Never copy passwords,
provider credentials, cookies or bearer tokens into app source or downloaded files.

## Build with MCP
Call get_started and list available tools. Respect the connection's granted scopes.
1. list_apps / get_app: inspect existing apps and form attachments.
2. create_app, then create_app_form: create forms within the app.
3. get_workspace_template: obtain the editable connected dashboard package.
4. get_app_project: read current client files, private actions and version.
5. publish_app_project: publish the complete package with expectedVersion
   (0 for a new deployment). Requires apps:write and screens:write.
6. update_app {appId, hostedDashboard:true}: use the published project as app home.
7. Open /app/<slug>/project or /app/<slug> to verify it. Publishing a project
   does not publish a draft parent app or grant membership automatically.

The client uses softn.backend.call(action, input, callback), with callbacks receiving
{result} or {error}. Host operations workspaceInfo, workspaceRecords {formId} and
workspaceOpen {formId} are restricted to the current app and its existing permissions.
Private actions define onRequest(ctx); ctx.db provides get/list/put/remove over the
app's SQLite records. Keep private action source in package.actions, not client files.
Downloaded client projects require a compatible authenticated host for backend calls.

## Native projects, editors and SQLite records
Use get_native_app_template for a working starter. Read get_native_app_project before
editing; publish_native_app_project and update_native_app_files require the current
expectedVersion. Native projects include .ui screens, private .logic route handlers,
manifest routes and numbered SQL migrations. Keep the app's own authentication or
choose FormLogic membership explicitly; owner administration is separate from visitors.

In App Studio, open Screens > Hosting & app tools > Native app hosting. Open Visual
Builder for layout or Open AI Studio for source/AI work. Review changes returns an
unpublished draft; Publish changes preserves database records. Editor previews do not
execute the hosted backend. Screens and Backend provide highlighted source editors.

list_native_app_records inspects the app's tables and record previews. For owner CRUD
through the UI, open Data & forms > Records > Database records: Add record creates,
View > Edit record loads full values, and Delete record requires confirmation. Writes
apply database constraints and connected record automations, but bypass the app's
backend validation functions. Do not use shortened list previews as replacement values.
Keep primary keys unchanged and handle stale-record conflicts by reloading, not by
blindly retrying. The owner session API is documented at /docs#native-records and in
docs/HOSTED_APPS.md#owner-record-api; do not assume a scoped MCP token is a web session.

Connect app.record.created.<table>, app.record.updated.<table> or
app.record.deleted.<table> through app flow bindings. Only committed future changes
on enabled bindings queue runs. Check run history; queued is not the same as completed.

## Compose apps and Aokie
Call get_aokie_starter to review its forms and capabilities, then
install_aokie_starter with an explicit approvedConnectorGrants list (empty is allowed).
Installation needs forms:write and screens:write; approved connector grants also need
connector:command. Verified-package-only workspaces use the /packs marketplace.
Connect the native plugin through OAIY,
then compose_apps {sourceAppId, appId, formIds?} to share existing forms and records.
Both apps must be owned by the user and allowed by the token. A token limited to one
app cannot read or import another app. No records are duplicated.
To move the integration, pass moveAutomation:true and the explicitly reviewed
approvedConnectorGrants. This requires connector:command, includes all source forms,
moves flows/bindings and pauses source event scripts. Wait for active runs to finish.
Destination branding, dashboard and member roles are preserved. Review those roles
before granting access to shared records; do not assume composition adds permissions.
Use list_app_roles, create_app_role and set_app_role_permissions to configure roles.
Permission updates replace the complete built-in list, preserving connector grants.
set_app_role_connector_grants separately replaces explicitly reviewed connector grants
and requires connector:command. Neither operation changes the immutable Owner role.

Use desktop_status and connector_command for permitted OAIY/Aokie diagnostics.
Report disconnected phones or missing speech engines honestly. Do not claim that
simulated calls, fixture data or an unpaired plugin prove real call/SMS delivery.
